fishing: WHEN: Saturday evening Oct 10. Small craft conditions easing; fish early mornings preferred. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/9 — tarpon and snook hanging in Gasparilla Pass; small mangrove snapper and grunts on the trestle. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper at Chadwick Park Pier, snook expected on the pilings, redfish and small snook on random docks; some trout on the flats. West Wall / McCall Flats: no fresh reports, redfish expected on the lower half. NEARSHORE: weather not conducive to reports this week. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters no October bite note (last June). Florida Sportsman Oct 9-12: excellent redfish schooling action on flats (live pilchards/shrimp), decent snook, black drum in passes. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, soft plastics, cut bait, gold spoons, small white paddletails.
redtide: FWC Oct 9: K. brevis background to very low in 11 Gulf samples. SWFL background Pinellas and Manatee, background to very low in and offshore Sarasota, background and very low Charlotte, background offshore Collier. No fish kills, no respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 16.
